name: craft_beers
label: Craft brewery and beer names
provenance: Wave-1 WS-1 batch 2, added 2026-07-24 on branch claude/next-three-items-nj7dyj. US and international craft beer and brewery names recalled from general knowledge - descriptive (IPA, Porter, Stout), whimsical (Hoppy Beer, Belly Dance) and branded (Stone IPA, Founders All Day); no brewery database was consulted. 25 of 398 lines carry digits, apostrophes or an umlaut (90 Minute, Bell's Two Hearted) and are grandfathered in scripts/check_data.py.
